aims.statement: This study aims to investigate the shape of the fused spine in the setting of a commonly utilized 'T10-pelvis' fusion, using a more detailed and comprehensive approach, and then to explore its potential association with proximal junctional kyphosis.

We hypothesize that certain shapes of the fused spine will correlate more closely with the development of PJK and that by measuring VPAs, we will be able to predict this post-operative spine contour and, therefore, the occurrence of PJK.
